user.title: spdbf Nearby Stops
user.description: Show public transport stops near a person on the map, using your own DBF (spdbf) server.

data.public_url: Public URL (for links to departure boards)

data_description.server_url: Address of the DBF Docker container on your network, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8092.
data_description.public_url: Optional. Where you open DBF in a browser, if that differs from the server URL. Each stop links here.
data_description.sources: DB uses DBF's built-in station list (DB InfraGO). Other entries are HAFAS services, e.g. BVG for Berlin buses, trams and U-Bahn.
data_description.departures: Set to 0 to show stops only, without departures.

error.not_dbf: The server answered, but it doesn't look like DBF.

missing_coordinates.title: spdbf doesn't send coordinates for some stops
missing_coordinates.description:
The DBF server at {server} returns HAFAS stops (such as BVG) without latitude and longitude, so they can't be shown on the map. DB stops still work.

To fix this, run the patched DBF image `ghcr.io/drakknar/db-fakedisplay` (see github.com/Drakknar/db-fakedisplay-patched). This notice disappears by itself once the server sends coordinates.
